service.description: The filters Commerce's reports share (ReportScope): the store (one of the user's; empty, every one of theirs, at most 25), the period (interval d, w, M, q or y, a calendar day, week, month, quarter or year; M by default) holding periodDate (yyyy-MM-dd, today by default), the currency (empty, each currency apart), and output csv for the export.

The reports Commerce owns for a user of its Reports area (design §3), each in Insights' catalog contract (entry id, owner app, title, description, route, parameters, export); none for another Commerce user. Refuses a user without Commerce.

Online sales (design §3 OnlineSales) of the stores over the last periodCount periods (6 by default, at most 24): per store, period and currency (a store alone: its rows are the totals), and the totals of these stores per currency with the change against the period before, each the owners' metrics (orders, items, gross, discounts, net sales of the placed orders; net invoiced of the issued invoices); the period's top products per currency. Refuses PERMISSION_DENIED (no Reports), RECORD_UNAVAILABLE (a store not the user's) and PERIOD_INVALID.

Home's period strip (design §1.2, §3 Home PeriodStrip): the chosen period's orders and net invoiced of the user's stores (or one) against the period before, per currency, and its top product; the same totals Online sales shows for the same stores and period. Every Commerce user's; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a store not theirs. Visits and conversion are left out until Marketing's tracking exists.
Cart recovery (design §3 CartRecovery) of the stores' carts opened in the period, per store and currency and in total per currency (Mantle's get#CartRecoverySummary). Refuses as get#OnlineSales.

Promotion use (design §3 PromotionUse) placed in the period, per promotion, code and currency and in total per currency (Mantle's get#PromotionUseSummary), of one promotion when given. Refuses as get#OnlineSales, and a promotion not of the user's stores RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.
